protocol: Each run: the service control manager lists the running services and the process hosting each; a real-time session of tools/InterCat.ProcessProbe enables Microsoft-Windows-Services at Verbose with every keyword and asks for its state, runs 60 seconds, and stops; the manager lists them again. The probe starts, stops and configures no service.
truth: The service control manager's own lists, by EnumServicesStatusEx, read as each session began and once it stopped, counted; never a PID or a service's name.
